output.description: HS 010121 covers live, pure-bred breeding horses, a sub-heading within the broader category of live horses, asses, mules and hinnies (HS 0101), itself part of Section I (live animals and animal products). This category is limited to horses recognized as pure-bred for breeding purposes, distinguishing it from other live-horse trade such as non-breeding or general-purpose animals. It is a narrow, animal-husbandry-specific commodity code rather than a manufactured or processed good.
